import Form.description: **Framework / Data mode.** Form that submits to a route action.

Form.description:
**Framework / Data mode.** Submits to the current route's `action` without a full page reload.
Works without JS as a plain HTML form — the progressive-enhancement baseline.

Form with action.description: **Framework / Data mode.** Targets another route's action. Omit `action` to post to the closest route.

Form with intent buttons.description:
**Framework / Data mode.** Several operations through one action: read `formData.get('intent')` and branch.
A submit button's `name`/`value` is included only when that button triggers the submit.

import Await.description: **Framework / Data mode.** Render a promise streamed from a loader.

Await.description:
**Framework / Data mode.** Renders a promise returned (not awaited) by a loader, so the page streams in while slow data resolves.
Must sit inside `<Suspense>`. The child can be a render function or a component calling `useAsyncValue()`.

body: export async function loader({ params }: Route.LoaderArgs) {
loader returning a promise (streaming).description:
**Framework mode.** Await what the page needs immediately, return the rest as an un-awaited promise and render it through `<Await>`.
Replaces the deprecated `defer()` — a bare promise in the returned object is streamed automatically.

Route lazy.description:
**Data mode.** Code-splits a Data mode route: the component *and* its loader are fetched on first visit.
Unlike `React.lazy`, this also defers the loader, so the route's data code stays out of the initial bundle.
